entities.summary: Dorothy Louise Bridges was an American actress and poet. Bridges was the matriarch of an acting family, which included her husband, Lloyd Bridges; two of their three sons, Beau Bridges and Jeff Bridges; and her grandson, Jordan Bridges. Bridges was sometimes credited as Dorothy Dean.
